_comment: Cookie Run BOX-FARM run-grind, EPISODE 3 — plays runs to collect Mystery Boxes ('?' boxes picked up mid-run, opened on the Mystery Box screen after Result). PRECONDITION: Episode 3 selected on home BEFORE starting — the bot only taps Play!, it does NOT navigate episode selection (future episodes get their own boxrun_epN.json). BOOST RULE: every run must be played with the +17% base speed Random Boost equipped. On each boost-shop entry the loop routes probe_speed first: if speedbase17_banner ('+17% base speed' pill) is already on the panel, skip buying; else buy_speed opens the Multi picker (where +17% base speed is PRE-TICKED by the game) and taps Multi-Buy, which auto-rolls, spending coins, until the +17% boost lands. This mirrors coinrun.json's Double-Coins multi-buy but pins SPEED instead of coins, and additionally taps the 'Tap to activate Fast Start Boost!' prompt at run start (faststart_btn, via tap_template + a faststart_check verify pass, since a fixed tap beside the drifting arrow silently wasted the boost). The Cookie Relay Boost tap (960,540) fires once per 4-hop cycle from guard_not_shop, gated behind both guards so it can't land on the home leaderboard. Coins exhausted mid-roll -> insufficient_coins cancels and force_play runs with whatever we have. Templates + coords reused from coinrun.json (same device, same 1920x1080) except the two new ones (faststart_btn.png, speedbase17_banner.png). Loop: home->Play->await_shop->probe_speed->buy_speed(Multi->Multi-Buy->wait_roll)->start_run(verify pill)->check_heart->Play->await_faststart->faststart_check->run(jump/slide chain)->run_result->mystery_box->reveal->home. IN-RUN PATTERN: 3 jump : 1 slide (J->J->S->J) so overhead bars (only slide clears them) are covered blind alongside pits (jump). Ratio + slide hold_ms are the first knobs to tune after a live Episode-3 test.

home._note: Main menu, detected by the episode-independent 'Play!' button (home_play_marker.png — see coinrun.json for why the old Episode-banner marker silently broke). Play! visible = nothing covers it, tap it. Absent -> a modal covers it or we're elsewhere: hand off to probe_sendlife (NEVER blind-tap from here). 3000ms wait covers the boost-shop fade-in before await_shop re-checks.

await_shop._note: Bridge between tapping Play! on home and acting in the boost shop (Play! shows THROUGH the shop fade above threshold — see coinrun.json for the double-tap loop this prevents). BUY DISABLED (temporary, user request): shop up -> check_heart directly, skipping probe_speed/buy_speed. To re-enable speed buying, change this goto (and boost_shop) back to 'probe_speed'. Absent -> one settle-retry (~1.2s via absent_wait_ms), then fall through to running.

probe_dailycheckin._note: New head of the modal-peeling chain. The 'Daily Check-in' calendar pops ONCE per day at first launch and sits ON TOP of home, hiding Play! — with no dismiss the whole bot stalls here (observed live: run loop never resumed). Detected by the unique 'Daily Check-in' banner title (dailycheckin_marker: self=1.000, in-run frame=0.232 — no false-positive). Present -> tap the green OK button (965,985, CV-located from the button's green blob) -> home re-checks. Absent -> fall to probe_sendlife, the rest of the chain unchanged.

probe_sendlife._note: Reached whenever Play! is not visible and no Daily Check-in popup was on screen. 'Send <friend> a free Life?' dialog pops over home when a stray tap lands on a leaderboard friend row. Tap Cancel (727,688 — gray, left); NEVER Confirm (1189,687). Detected by the unique 'Gift Points' text. Dismissed -> home. Absent -> try the boost shop next.

boost_shop._note: Boost shop open (entry point for guard/probe re-routing). BUY DISABLED (temporary): route straight to check_heart. Re-enable: change goto to 'probe_speed'.

probe_speed._note: SPEED GUARD: the run must be played with +17% base speed equipped. speedbase17_banner.png ('+17% base speed' pill) shows on the shop's right panel whenever that boost is currently rolled/equipped (CV: pill present score=1.000; absent ~0.33-0.38, split clean by the 0.82 threshold). Present -> skip buying, go to the Play gate. Absent -> buy_speed opens the Multi picker to roll it.

buy_speed._note: No +17% speed equipped (probe_speed confirmed pill absent). Tap the pink 'Multi' toggle (1649,337) on the Random Boost panel to open the 'Pick desired Boosts!' picker. The picker opens with +17% base speed ALREADY TICKED (CV verified live — the only checked row), so we do NOT tap any boost row (tapping the +17% row would un-tick it). Hand to picker.

picker._note: 'Pick desired Boosts!' popup (picker_marker, CV 1.000 @960,100). +17% base speed stays PRE-TICKED — DO NOT tap any row (each is a toggle; tapping the ticked row un-ticks it). Tap Multi-Buy (953,899) ONCE — the game then AUTO-ROLLS by itself, spending coins repeatedly, until the ticked boost (+17% speed) lands, then stops on its own. Do NOT re-tap or re-open. Hand to wait_roll to sit still until the roll UI is gone. ABSENT means the picker never opened (Multi tap missed or still animating): one settle-retry (~1.2s), then retry_buy (re-check coins, re-open the buy flow) — NO roll is in flight, so never fall through to Play with no boost.

wait_roll._note: The game's self-rolling multi-buy is in progress (multibuy_marker / Multi-Buy UI still on screen, CV 1.000 @960,860). Do NOTHING — no taps — just wait and self-loop so we never interrupt the roll. The game keeps rolling until +17% speed lands, then the roll UI disappears. Marker absent -> roll finished -> read the pill in start_run. Generous timeout because several rolls can chain; on timeout fall through to start_run anyway (nocoins handling downstream).

check_boost_result._note: Auto-roll finished, picker closed back to the boost shop. Check 'Not enough Coins!' first (balance ran dry mid-roll) -> cancel. Otherwise read the pill in start_run. We do NOT re-roll here — the game rolled to completion.

insufficient_coins._note: SAFETY: 'Not enough Coins!' popup. Tap Cancel (770,685) — NEVER Confirm (1150,685), which spends gems. Then Play! with whatever boost we have (or none).

force_play._note: Coins exhausted — stop chasing the speed boost, Play! with whatever we have. Still route through check_heart so we don't run on empty hearts.

start_run._note: SPEED ENFORCEMENT: reached only AFTER wait_roll confirmed the roll UI is gone. Pill present -> the roll landed +17% speed -> check_heart -> Play. Pill ABSENT -> the roll never landed it (or the picker never opened) -> retry_buy, which buys again until we do. The only sanctioned Play-without-speed path is the nocoins escape (insufficient_coins -> force_play).

retry_buy._note: Re-buy gate: we ended up without the +17% speed boost and must roll again. Check the wallet FIRST so we never spin on an empty balance: 'Not enough Coins!' up -> insufficient_coins (Cancel, then force_play — the ONLY sanctioned Play-without-speed path). No popup -> coins remain, loop back into buy_speed. Termination is natural (each roll drains coins until the game raises nocoins); a genuinely stuck loop trips the engine's 100-poll livelock warning.

check_heart._note: SINGLE Play gate, reached from probe_speed/start_run/force_play (all BOOST-SHOP context, Play at 1365,931). heart_empty.png = separator '|' + FIRST (leftmost) heart gray, cropped live at 0 hearts — hearts deplete right-to-left, so slot 1 is gray ONLY at 0 hearts. CV: 0 hearts=1.000; 1-3 hearts ~0.75 (thin margin, don't raise match_threshold). Present -> wait 30s and self-loop until a heart regenerates (timeout 25 min). HARD RULE: never buy hearts. Absent -> >=1 heart -> tap Play, then hand to await_faststart to catch the Fast Start prompt.

await_faststart._note: Right after Play, the run loads and shows 'Tap to activate Fast Start Boost!' with a blue-arrow button. faststart_btn.png is that button's blue-arrow disc + green glow (CV: prompt=1.000; mid-run tray icon 0.197, bonustime 0.255, shop 0.335 — no false-positive). check_heart waits 3700ms after Play: a 10-run test showed the prompt appears ~3.7s in, so at 3000ms the first check missed 100% of the time. The tap is tap_template, NOT a fixed (985,515): the prompt's arrow drifts a little between runs, and a fixed tap that lands beside it silently wastes the boost — tap_template hits wherever the button actually rendered. Retries widened to 5 x ~500ms (~2.5s of extra window) since the prompt lingers a few seconds and a missed catch costs a whole run's fast start. Verify via faststart_check rather than assuming the tap took.

faststart_check._note: Did the Fast Start tap actually land? Button still on screen -> the tap missed (or the prompt was mid-animation) -> tap it again and re-check. Gone -> either it activated or the prompt expired; either way the run is underway, so proceed. absent_retries is 0 here on purpose: one clean 'button gone' reading is enough. The self-loop is bounded by timeout_ms -> running, so a stuck prompt can never trap the bot.

running._note: In-run (auto-play). Result popup up -> run over. Not up -> we MIGHT still be running, but could equally be on home or in the shop, so DON'T tap yet: hand off to the guard chain.

guard_not_home._note: Guard 1/2 before any in-run tap: Play! on screen -> we're on home, not running.

guard_not_shop._note: Guard 2/2: in the boost shop -> resume via boost_shop. Neither Play! nor shop visible -> accept 'mid-run' and fire the first jump plus the Cookie Relay Boost tap (960,540), then enter the fast-jump chain (jump_2..jump_4). The relay fires ONLY here — once per 4-hop cycle — because the tap sits at screen centre: if the run has already ended without us noticing, that same tap lands on the home leaderboard and opens the Friend's Info popup stack. Both guards ran on this frame, so we know we're mid-run before it fires, and the jump zone (~238,940) doesn't overlap the relay, so both are safe together.

jump_2._note: Hop 2/4 — jump. One capture per hop, spent on the only mid-run question: result popup up? If not, jump again.

jump_3._note: Hop 3/4 — the SLIDE hop of the J->J->S->J anti-collision cycle. Overhead bars are the one obstacle class a jump can never clear; one slide per 4-hop cycle (~every 3-4s) sweeps them without giving up much pit coverage. Slide zone = the 'Slide' button bottom-right (~1671,937), press-and-hold via act.py (default ~550ms clears a typical low bar). Same detect contract: result up -> run over.

jump_4._note: Hop 4/4 — jump, last hop before a housekeeping pass through the probe chain (popups don't expire on their own; sweeping every ~4 hops clears them at a quarter of the capture cost).

check_shop_after_run._note: Result popup not up yet — still running, home is back, or we're in the shop. Try home; absent -> walk the probe chain.

probe_boostshop._note: Recovery probe: sitting in the boost shop (process started there, or run ended straight into shop)? boost_shop routes to probe_speed.

probe_congrats._note: Level-up 'Congratulations!' popup (free reward). Confirm (956,846) is safe/free.

probe_levelup._note: Separate 'Level Up' popup (gems/coins/score-bonus, distinct from the Congratulations ticket popup). Confirm (959,969) is safe/free.

probe_rankingrewards._note: SAFETY NET: gold 'Ranking Rewards' season popup opened by a stray leaderboard tap. X at (1672,135), free/safe.

probe_giftdraw._note: SAFETY NET: 'Gift Draw' popup over home. Tap X (1685,170) — never Draw; the farm loop must not auto-consume gift draws.

probe_friendinfo._note: SAFETY NET: 'Friend's ___' popup family (can stack 2 layers). Tap inner X (1552,117) then outer X (1633,107) each pass, self-loop until the ribbon is gone.

run_result._note: Result popup after a run. Tap OK (702,940) — NOT 'Show Off'. After OK the Mystery Box screen appears on runs that collected a '?' box — the whole point of this bot — handled by mystery_box.

mystery_box._note: After Result-OK we either land on home, or the 'Mystery Box' screen blocks it. Detect the BOX screen positively. Present -> tap the closed box (960,540) and read the reward. Absent -> home (or a modal; home's probe chain handles it).

mystery_box_reveal._note: Reward reveal can show MULTIPLE ingredients — one Confirm tap only advances to the next item. Self-loop: keep tapping Confirm (959,960) while the 'Mystery Box' title is still up; fall through to mystery_box_recheck once it's gone.

mystery_box_recheck._note: After collecting the box: Play! visible -> home is clear, continue the loop. Not visible -> something still covers it; go through probe_sendlife, never blind-tap.
